keyframe_review.note: 63,232 km2 (bbox 114.88-119.80 E, 38.55-41.52 N: Beijing, Tianjin and northern Hebei). The Yan page gives no area and says only 'near present-day Beijing', so the extent is unverified. The years are wrong: 'established by Liu Shouguang in 911' and 'destroyed by Li Cunxu ... after lasting about two years'; the Jin page says 'in 913, conquered Yan' and the Li Cunxu page puts the siege of You Prefecture by summer 913. Cliopatria runs the shape to 921, eight years too long; 914-921 is Jin land (former-jin). [orchestrator 2 Nov 2026: from/to set to 911..913 from this entry's own 'valid 911-913 only'; without them the compiler drew the shape for all its Cliopatria years, overlapping the next keyframe (window p1100-p1199 report)]

region.text: You Prefecture and the Lulong circuit, near present-day Beijing

ledger.note: 911: Liu Shouguang proclaims the Yan at You Prefecture. The state was 'established by Liu Shouguang in 911' (infobox 'Established: 911'), with its capital at You Prefecture near Beijing; the page gives no month. It was sometimes called Jie Yan after the tyrant Jie of the Xia dynasty. Confidence 2 (lowered by the ea-04-d reviewer): the page names the year and the capital, not the extent drawn.

913: Li Cunxu's Jin destroys the Yan. The Jin page: 'in 913, conquered Yan'; the Li Cunxu page: 'By summer 913, Zhou had put Yan's capital You Prefecture (幽州) under siege' and Liu Shouguang 'was subsequently captured'. The Yan page's infobox gives 914 for the end and for his death, the Five Dynasties page 915.

wars.name: Jin conquest of Yan
wars.outcome: Zhou put You Prefecture under siege by summer 913; Liu Shouguang fled with his wives and children, was captured, and the Yan was destroyed; the Yan page dates the end to 914.
wars.note: The Five Dynasties page says Li Cunxu 'defeated Liu Shouguang ... in 915'.

certainty.note: The Yan realm is known only as the area round You Prefecture near Beijing; no page gives its prefectures or a frontier.

notes: Cliopatria row Yan Kingdom 911-921 (one shape, 63,232 km2). The state lasted 911-913: the Yan page's infobox says 'Established 911, Disestablished 914' and 'about two years', the Jin page says Jin conquered Yan in 913, the Five Dynasties page says Li Cunxu defeated Liu Shouguang in 915. 913 is used for the end and for the Jin gain (former-jin 913); the other two years are in the notes of both events. The shape's land is unverified beyond 'near present-day Beijing': the pages open give no prefectures, wars with the Later Liang, Zhao or Yiwu, nor Khitan relations (the Yan page is a stub). Cliopatria's 914-921 years are Jin (Former Jin) land, which the former-jin dossier draws. Liao (Khitan) is listed by Cliopatria as a 911-921 neighbour; no opened page mentions it. Infobox gives no area, so no ratio. Budget 1-2 pages: the Yan page was opened and the Jin and Li Cunxu pages (opened for former-jin) were used for the end.
